Unexplained shadows in dense forests, eerie voices captured in the dead of night, and legendary creatures lurking just beyond reach. Step into Expedition X where cutting-edge science meets fearless field investigation to confront the most terrifying paranormal and cryptid encounters. From cursed swamps and haunted ruins to remote wilderness hotspots, every expedition tests the limits of what science can explain.
Watch Expedition X Season 3 Episodes 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 8, 9 & 10 on Discovery Channel India.
